Secret Orders step 14 needs the neutral Arawn commander on the hill NE of Caer Sursbrooke; no such NPC existed, so the step pointed at keep Armsman Commanders that change with keep ownership. Level 50 neutral per Uthgard; look borrowed from the isolationist paladin (model 32 with its plate equipment) as no period source gives his model
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 351 Secret Orders: 'some Arawn Commander that will be neutral to you (location is Pennine Mountains 38912, 8709). Located NE of Caer Sursbrook, on top of a hill' = region 1 X 604160 Y 360965 (Z from the navmesh); Uthgard bestiary monster 25626 'Arawn Commander' Pennine Mountains, level 50, neutral
